qualifier: essential linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid metabolism
name: Fatty acid elongation and essential fatty acid metabolism
rationale: All members concern chain elongation of saturated, long- and very-long-chain fatty acids or metabolism of the essential omega-6/omega-3 fatty acids, which the peroxisomal oxidation and ether-lipid confusables lack.

qualifier: defensins, microbe cytolysis, nematode and chitin response
name: Defensin and lytic mucosal defence against microbes and nematodes
rationale: Members share innate killing or neutralisation of microbes and parasites (defensins, agglutination, cytolysis, mucosal immunity, nematode/chitin response), whereas confusables centre on metal sequestration, antifungal responses or antimicrobial peptide production.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defences
qualifier: mycobacterial immune evasion and bacterial toxins
name: Host defence subversion by mycobacteria and bacterial toxins
rationale: Members describe pathogens manipulating host cells (Mtb suppression of autophagy, apoptosis, NO, phagolysosome fusion; anthrax and diphtheria toxins), unlike confusables focused on Listeria entry, phagosome acidification or DC/IL-10 signalling.

name: TNFR1-induced canonical NF-kappaB signalling and linear ubiquitination
rationale: Members concern TNFR1 signalling and positive/negative control of NF-kappaB transcription factor activity via linear ubiquitin, distinct from confusables on DUBs, non-canonical NIK signalling or TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment.

qualifier: drug disposition by SLC22 and SLCO transporters
name: Drug disposition by organic anion and cation transporters
rationale: All members concern SLC22/SLCO-type organic ion transport and drug ADME (statins, aspirin, prednisone, ciprofloxacin, abacavir), while confusables add bilirubin conjugation and Rotor/Dubin-Johnson hyperbilirubinaemia.

name: Stress-induced premature senescence and Polycomb silencing
rationale: Members cover oxidative/stress-induced senescence, SASP and BMI1-centred Polycomb repression of cell-cycle genes, whereas confusables emphasise oncogene-induced, replicative or p53/UV-driven arrest.

name: Chaperonin folding of tubulin and actin, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members describe CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin, tubulin and G-beta plus tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and severing, which the general-chaperone and acetylation confusables lack.

qualifier: blood-group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood-group glycans and sulfated selectin ligands
rationale: Members share GDP-fucose metabolism, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis and tyrosine sulfation supporting selectin-mediated leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, unlike the nucleotide-sugar transporter and O/N-glycan confusables.

name: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel defects
rationale: Members concern SLC12 cation-coupled chloride cotransporters, their Gitelman/Bartter/ACCPN defects and potassium channels, distinct from magnesium paracellular, renal sodium regulation and SLC26 anion-exchange confusables.

qualifier: TAK1 activation and AP-1 immediate-early response
name: TAK1-JNK/p38 stress kinase signalling and AP-1 early response
rationale: Members cover TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 activation, AP-1 factors and growth-factor immediate-early genes, while confusables add ALPK1/TNF signalling, UV responses or ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: histamine signalling, TRP channels and itch
name: Histamine signalling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members share histamine receptors and metabolism, TRP channels, gastric acid secretion, GI smooth muscle contraction and itch, whereas confusables involve serotonin, tachykinin, muscarinic or urinary smooth muscle.

name: DNA mismatch repair and mismatch-repair gene defects
rationale: Members describe MutSalpha/MutSbeta-directed mismatch repair and defects in MSH2, MSH3, MSH6, MLH1 and PMS2, unlike confusables on somatic hypermutation, recombination or base excision repair.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome and autophagic protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, DUBs, proteasome assembly, ERAD regulation and aggrephagy/CMA of misfolded proteins, whereas confusables centre on chaperonin folding, ribosome stalling or neddylation.

name: Amyloid fibril assembly and amyloid precursor processing regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril and neurofibrillary tangle formation and APP synthesis/catabolism, whereas confusables focus on amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation.

name: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release and its G-protein modulation
rationale: Members cover calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and exocytosis of transmitters and Gbeta-gamma/GIRK presynaptic inhibition, distinct from postsynaptic AMPA/kainate and vesicle-recycling confusables.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and melanosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related granule biogenesis and light/UV-A responses, unlike intestinal-epithelium and keratinocyte confusables.

qualifier: monocyte activation, adhesion molecule and hyaluronan control
name: Monocyte activation and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion control
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation/aggregation, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, extravasation and adhesion-molecule, MMP and hyaluronan output, whereas confusables emphasise chemotaxis, inflammatory cytokines or integrin migration.

name: Adipocyte triglyceride storage, lipid droplet dynamics and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover TAG/DAG/PA synthesis, lipid droplet formation and turnover, lipolysis, lipophagy and adipogenesis, unlike confusables on fatty acid oxidation, PC synthesis or LXR lipogenesis.

qualifier: renal sodium export and potassium import
name: Regulation of renal sodium export and potassium import
rationale: All members regulate sodium and potassium transmembrane transport in kidney, lacking the P-type ATPase, SLC12 cotransporter and osmosensory members of confusables.

name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition with zygotic chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members describe MZT, pronuclear epigenetic programming, cleavage and zygotic-factor maternal mRNA decay, unlike confusables on maternal M-decay or germline piRNA/spermatogenesis.

name: Retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26 catabolism and cellular response
rationale: Members concern RA biosynthesis from retinal, CYP26-mediated catabolism and its defects, and responses to vitamin A/RA, distinct from retinol transport, vitamin D and steroid confusables.

core: Nuclear RNA 3' processing and surveillance decay
name: Nuclear exosome-mediated RNA 3' processing and surveillance decay
rationale: Members cover 3'-5' exosome trimming and decay of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs, tRNAs and nuclear mRNAs, whereas confusables concern NMD/ribosome rescue, nucleolar rRNA cleavage or siRNA.

name: Nuclear tRNA processing and tRNA-fragment and siRNA biogenesis
rationale: Members describe tRNA 5'/3' end processing and intron splicing plus tRF and siRNA biogenesis, unlike mitochondrial RNA processing and nuclear exosome decay confusables.

qualifier: NUDT sanitization and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members share NTP hydrolysis by NUDT enzymes and metabolism of thiopurine, ribavirin and abacavir (TPMT methylation), whereas confusables cover purine/pyrimidine salvage, de novo synthesis or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: oxidized LDL and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor oxidized-LDL uptake and foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors, oxLDL response, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, unlike confusables on cholesterol efflux or apoptotic-cell clearance.
